label: SG Replicate (pre-2.8 inter-Sync Gateway replication)
type: the HTTP-based predecessor mechanism to sgw:inter-sync-gateway-replication (ISGR), which is websocket-based and was introduced in Sync Gateway 2.8. Can coexist with 2.8+ ISGR on the same node, with an explicit precedence/coexistence caveat.
evidence: This content relates only to inter-Sync Gateway replication in Sync Gateway 2.8+. For documentation on pre-2.8 inter-Sync Gateway replication, see SG-Replicate.
note: Minted in overview.json, reused in run.json ('inter-Sync Gateway replications introduced in Sync Gateway 2.8 as well as SG-Replicate can run on the same node, but you must ensure that...'). Distinct from the ISGR/XDCR question this round's coordinator decision addresses - this is an internal Sync Gateway generational split (HTTP-based predecessor to websocket-based ISGR), not a cross-product comparison.
